technique_name: Summarize the article "The Benefits of an Online Education".
description: An online education has many advantages and benefits over traditional classroom learning. It offers flexible scheduling, self-paced learning, affordability, and access to resources around the world. Online learning also encourages collaboration with peers and gives students the ability to create a personalized learning environment.
